title: Fleet declaration body
description: A declared group of agent persons under one organization, with a shared sponsor. Issued by the org; envelope subject is the fleet DID. Agents join by naming the fleet on their passport, and their sponsor must be the fleet's org. Declared fleets are legitimate coordination; the same pattern undeclared is flagged.

org.description: The accountable organization or human; sponsor of every member.

template.description: What members share: the basis for a template-level reputation.
